title: AI 智能体开始接管桌面、Git 与记忆
opening: 今天的榜单几乎被 AI 智能体的周边工具占满：从让智能体直接操作桌面应用的 agent-desktop，到为并行智能体管理 Git worktree 的 worktrunk，再到给 Claude Code 做持久记忆的 claude-mem。最值得留意的是 vercel-labs/agent-desktop 和 max-sixty/worktrunk，它们分别从“看屏幕”和“管分支”两个角度，补上了智能体真正干活时缺的那块基础设施。

projects.summary: 给 Claude Code 等智能体做跨会话记忆压缩，自动抓取工具调用观察并生成语义摘要，下次会话再注入。

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
projects.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent-desktop Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree. agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. Install Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from GitHub Releases and keep its helper beside the executable. On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet. The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket. Release archives and building from source are cov
projects.summary: 让 AI 智能体通过操作系统无障碍树“看”并操作桌面应用，返回带 ref 的 JSON，不靠截图和像素匹配。
projects.problem: 智能体拿到每个可操作元素的 ref 后点击或输入，再重新读取 UI 验证结果，循环逻辑留在智能体侧。它本身不含模型，只提供 CLI 和 C 库；快照和剪贴板可能含隐私内容，需要自行隔离日志。

projects.name: max-sixty/worktrunk
projects.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
projects.readmeExcerpt: Worktrunk > **November 2026**: Worktrunk was released at the start of the year, and has quickly become the most popular git worktree manager. It's built with love (there's no slop!). Please let me know any frictions at all; I'm intensely focused on continuing to make Worktrunk excellent, and the biggest help is folks posting problems they perceive. Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel. Worktrunk's three core commands make worktrees as easy as branches. Plus, Worktrunk has a bunch of quality-of-life features to simplify working with many parallel changes, including hooks to automate local workflows & copy-on-write build caches. A quick demo: > ### 📚 Full documentation at worktrunk.dev 📚 Context: git worktrees AI agents like Claude Code and Codex can handle longer tasks without supervision, such that it's possible to manage 5-10+ in parallel. Git's native worktree feature gives each agent its own working directory, so they don't step on each other's changes. But the git worktree UX is clunky. Even a task as small as starting a new worktree requires typing the branch name three times: `git worktree add -b feat ../repo
projects.summary: 把 git worktree 包装成三条核心命令，让并行跑多个 AI 智能体时各自有独立工作目录，互不踩踏。
projects.problem: 原生 git worktree 的 UX 很别扭，起一个新工作树要反复输入分支名。Worktrunk 用钩子自动化本地流程，还支持写时复制构建缓存；但它假设你已经在并行管理多个智能体，单线程用户收益有限。

projects.name: JustVugg/colibri
projects.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Website · Discord · English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Italiano · 日本語 · Bahasa Indonesia · Português (Brasil) **Tiny engine, immense model.** colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture-of-experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them. Pure C, one file per model family, no GPU required. Thirteen engines run today. Ten are for language models: **GLM-5.2/5.3** (which also runs **Mistral-Large-4**), **GLM-5.3-Flash**, **Inkling**, **Kimi K3**, **DeepSeek V4 Flash**, **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash**, **MiMo-V2.6 Flash** (and Pro), **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next**, **Qwen3.6** (which also runs Qwen3-Coder, the dense Qwen3.8-27B, **Flint**, **Muse Spark Open** and **LFM3-VL**) and **OLMoE**. One draws pictures: **Qwen-Image-2.1**. Two answer decisions: **Laya** and **GLiNER2.5-Decide**, with a third decision model, **Clef**, on the Qwen3.6 engine. The language models also run from the GGUF files already published, read as they are (GGUF), on the CPU, on any GPU through Vulkan and on NVIDIA cards through CUDA. Which one f
projects.summary: 纯 C 写的 MoE 推理引擎，热专家放 GPU、温专家放内存、冷专家从 NVMe 流式读取，让大模型跑在现有硬件上。
projects.problem: 它利用 MoE 每 token 只激活少量专家的特性，把其余专家留在磁盘按需读取，无需 GPU 也能跑。已支持十余个模型家族，但“从磁盘流式读专家”意味着实际速度受存储带宽制约，适合尝鲜而非高吞吐场景。

projects.name: mattpocock/skills
projects.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Skills For Real Engineers My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding. Developing real applications is hard. Approaches like GSD, BMAD, and Spec-Kit try to help by owning the process. But while doing so, they take away your control and make bugs in the process hard to resolve. These skills are designed to be small, easy to adapt, and composable. They work with any model. They're based on decades of engineering experience. Hack around with them. Make them your own. Enjoy. If you want to keep up with changes to these skills, and any new ones I create, you can join ~60,000 other devs on my newsletter: Sign Up To The Newsletter Installation (30-second setup) A plugin updates itself. skills.sh copies editable files into your project, and you update them by hand. Pick one per agent, because installing both gives you every skill twice. 1. Get the skills Claude Code Updates itself by default. Codex Updates itself at startup. GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code) Then, once, add to `~/.copilot/settings.json`: In VS Code, run **Chat: Install Plugin From Source** and enter `https://github.com/mattpocock/skills`. It updates daily. Gemini CLI (manual updates) Re-run
projects.summary: 一套作者日常使用的智能体技能集，强调小而可组合、不接管流程，和 GSD、BMAD 那类重流程方案反着来。
projects.problem: 这些技能面向真实工程而非“氛围编程”，可搭配任意模型，安装后按项目或插件方式更新。它的价值在于保持开发者控制权，但技能本身偏个人工作流，直接套用前需要按自己习惯裁剪。

projects.name: p-e-w/heretic
projects.description: Training-free language model modification: Remove censorship, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more
projects.readmeExcerpt: Heretic Training-free language model modification **Remove censorship**, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more. All in an afternoon, on your gaming PC.                     Modify any LLM that you can run on your hardware[^1] [^1]: Heretic supports on-the-fly 4-bit model quantization with bitsandbytes, which can reduce the amount of VRAM required to process a model to the same amount that is used to run a typical quantized version of it, at a slight accuracy cost. Set the `quantization` option to `bnb_4bit` to enable this. Heretic is a unique tool that lets you do what only corporations with access to massive computing power usually do: *Modify,* rather than merely run, language models. It does not perform expensive training; rather, it uses a collection of mathematical techniques to steer behavior based on contrasting example prompts and matching scorers. Heretic can, depending on the configuration: * **Suppress refusals/remove censorship** (this is the default action) * Reduce slop (`config.noslop.toml`) * Reduce humor (`config.nohumor.toml`) * Reduce sycophancy (`config.nosyco.toml`) * Alter emotional
projects.summary: 无需训练就能修改语言模型行为：移除审查、压制废话、降低谄媚，靠对比示例和打分器做数学 steering。
projects.problem: 它用一组数学技巧在推理时引导模型行为，支持 4-bit 量化以降低显存门槛，一个下午能在游戏 PC 上跑完。但效果取决于示例和打分器的配置，属于行为微调而非重新训练，边界并不精确。

projects.name: spotify/portal-ai-plugins
projects.readmeExcerpt: Spotify Portal AI Plugins Bring Spotify Portal into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi. This plugin provides focused workflows for the Portal CLI: set up authentication, search your software catalog, build service briefings, run diagnostics, and invoke Portal actions. Highlights - Set up the Portal CLI for your current coding-agent environment. - Run read-only diagnostics to verify plugin, CLI, authentication, and action readiness. - Search the software catalog and technical documentation using natural language queries. - Generate concise service briefings with available ownership, health, incident, and documentation details. - Discover and safely invoke Portal actions with built-in help, dry-run, and confirmation safeguards. - Create, run, check, and troubleshoot Fleetshift shifts, open PRs from completed runs, and stop a run on request. The marketplace also ships **shunt** (Claude Code only for now): a plugin that routes I/O-heavy agent work — bulk file reads and boilerplate generation — to AiKA modes running cheaper worker models, via the Portal CLI actions registry. See `plugins/shunt/README.md`. Installation Claude Code Start a new session and run: Codex Open `/plugins`, insta
projects.summary: 把 Spotify Portal 接进 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编码智能体，提供目录搜索、服务简报和只读诊断。
projects.problem: 插件围绕 Portal CLI 做认证、搜索软件目录、生成服务简报并安全调用 Portal 动作，自带 dry-run 和确认保护。另附 shunt 插件把批量读文件和样板生成路由到更便宜的 worker 模型，但目前仅限 Claude Code。

projects.name: floci-io/floci
projects.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
projects.readmeExcerpt: Any Cloud. Locally. Light, fluffy, and always free No account. No auth token. No feature gates. Just docker compose up . Quick Start · Features · Services · SDKs · Testcontainers · Migration · Docs What is Floci? Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI. It gives you AWS-shaped services on your machine without requiring a cloud account, an auth token, or paid feature gates. Point your AWS SDK, CLI, Terraform, CDK, OpenTofu, or test suite at `http://localhost:4566` and keep your existing workflows. Already using LocalStack? Floci is a drop-in replacement: swap the image and keep going. See Migrating from LocalStack. Floci is the AWS member of the Floci emulator family, named after floccus, the cloud formation that looks like popcorn. | Emulator | Cloud | Port | | **floci** | **AWS** | **4566** | | floci-az | Azure | 4577 | | floci-gcp | GCP | 4588 | | floci-oci | OCI | 4599 | Quick Start The fastest way to run Floci is with the official CLI No Docker? Each release also ships a standalone `floci-aws` binary for Linux, macOS and Windows; see Native binary. Export the AWS environment variables: Use your existing AWS tools normally: Watch it run T
projects.summary: 免费开源的本地 AWS 模拟器，docker compose up 就能在 localhost:4566 跑起 S3、EC2、ECS 等服务。
projects.problem: 不需要云账号、认证令牌或付费功能门，现有 AWS SDK、CLI、Terraform 和测试套件直接指过来即可。它自称 LocalStack 的 drop-in 替代，换镜像就能迁移；但模拟覆盖度是否够全，仍需按自己的服务清单验证。

closing: 今天真正值得看的是智能体基础设施的“补课”：记忆、桌面操作、分支隔离都在从 demo 走向日常工具。colibri 和 heretic 则提醒，模型侧的本土化改造也在加速。
